# Science Trivia Full Guide

Science Trivia is a public English-language website available at https://science-trivia.com. It provides a free online science trivia quiz and a growing archive of themed science trivia explanations.

The homepage lets visitors generate a short set of five science trivia questions. A quiz round includes multiple-choice questions, correct answers, and plain-language explanations. The site is designed for curious readers who want quick science questions and answers that reveal the mechanism behind each fact rather than only testing memorization.

## What This Site Contains
- An interactive homepage for generating five-question science trivia quizzes.
- Science trivia questions with answers and explanations.
- A topic archive of biweekly science trivia features.
- Longer science articles that connect related facts around one theme.
- Standard crawl discovery files such as `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt`.
- Legal pages for privacy and terms.

## Topic Coverage
- Science Trivia focuses on science rather than broad general trivia.
- Topics may include everyday science, biology, chemistry, physics, astronomy, sleep science, plant science, materials science, human body trivia, anatomy, perception, neuroscience, light, color, scientific scale, heat transfer, sensory biology, and common science misconceptions.
- Archive features often begin from a memorable science trivia question and expand it into related explanations.

## Primary Entry Points
- [Homepage](https://science-trivia.com/): Best starting point for the five-question science quiz experience.
- [Archive](https://science-trivia.com/archive): Index of published biweekly science trivia features.
- [Sitemap](https://science-trivia.com/sitemap.xml): Best source for discovering crawlable canonical URLs.
- [Robots](https://science-trivia.com/robots.txt): Crawl policy reference.

## Canonical URL Patterns
- `https://science-trivia.com/`
  Interactive science trivia quiz homepage.
- `https://science-trivia.com/archive`
  Archive index for published science trivia features.
- `https://science-trivia.com/archive/<topic-slug>`
  One science trivia feature article.
- `https://science-trivia.com/legal/privacy`
  Privacy policy.
- `https://science-trivia.com/legal/terms`
  Terms of service.

## Example Archive Topics
- `https://science-trivia.com/archive/everyday-science-trivia`
- `https://science-trivia.com/archive/sleep-science-trivia`


## Content Guidance For AI Crawlers
- Start from the homepage when describing the main user experience: generating and answering five science trivia questions.
- Start from the sitemap when discovering canonical pages.
- Use archive topic pages for deeper science explanations, themed facts, and citation targets.
- Prefer canonical HTML pages for retrieval, summaries, and citations.
- Do not describe the site as a broad general trivia site. Its editorial focus is science trivia, science questions, science facts, and science explanations.

## Recommended Crawl Priorities
1. Homepage
2. Published archive topic pages
3. Archive index
4. Sitemap
